verification_scope: Fresh independent agent; no design documents, README design, or prior verification reports read
Loaded base and final blend separately; compared actual vertex arrays, matrices, world vertex arrays and all world bound corners
Traced every Noise/Brick Vector input through shader links to Geometry.Position
Loaded terrain.npz and scene.json directly; mesh terrain checked against NPZ XYZ; camera vertical ray casts independently measured actual mesh ground

visual_inspection.academy_readability: 02 central hall entrance, window frames and dome copper ribs clearly readable; 05 campus building groups, main axis and gate opening clearly readable
visual_inspection.mountain_rim_background: Large continuous mountain rim prominently fills backdrop in both views
visual_inspection.crater_lake: Not visible in either final image; no claim that crater lake can be seen
visual_inspection.materials: Paving and wall joints plausibly restrained at final framing; roof textures and some side surfaces retain visible vertical streaking; mountain terrain remains smooth and simplified
visual_inspection.foreground_occlusion: 02 left building trims edge without hiding main hall; 05 gate occludes bottom of avenue naturally, main hall and campus groups remain readable
visual_inspection.gate_passage: Open central doorway visibly clear in 05; independent projection of every added mesh finds no intrusion in 4m-wide passage below 2.2m
limitations: Sparse polygonal shrubs and cone trees remain schematic
Terrain is coarse and smooth, not naturalistic relief detail
Portico stair profile is visually block-like at 02 distance
Low-resolution rerender verifies self-contained saved source, not pixel-perfect final image reproducibility

camera_precision_note: Camera offsets exactly satisfy source NPZ bilinear interpolation within 0.001m. Actual mesh vertical ray offsets are 1.704585075m and 24.985347748m: differences from nominal +1.7/+25 are +4.585mm and -14.652mm. A strict millimetre-level actual-mesh-height requirement is not met; report distinguishes this from NPZ interpolation.
source_trace: rebuild_terrain.py obtains grid from campus.py ground/sample at 10m intervals; render_camera_tests.py patches build_3d.py to load this terrain NPZ and loads scene.json. Independent audit confirms all 120960 terrain mesh vertices match NPZ XYZ within 0.0000762m float32 coordinate error.
category_count_semantics: Category counts are actual added object name matches (components), not counts of complete door/window assemblies. door=12 refers to central hall door components; logistics entrance is additionally present under entrance naming (script/source observed), gate leaves counted separately. Blender name truncation can omit panel suffix on long Chinese names.
